en.topic_title: Hong Kong to consider historic grade status for popular Kennedy Town seaside photo spot
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong is considering granting historic grade status to a picturesque seaside spot along the Kennedy Town waterfront that has surged in popularity among mainland tourists.



People line up to take a photo outside a coffee shop near the Kennedy Town Praya, on August 15, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



According to a memorandum from the Antiquities and Monuments Office, the seawall in New Praya, Kennedy Town, is being considered for Grade 2 status.
